title: Battle of Aphek: the Ark Captured and Eli Dies
summary: The Philistines defeat Israel at Ebenezer/Aphek, capture the Ark and kill Hophni and Phinehas; Eli, aged 98, falls and dies after judging Israel forty years (1 Sam 4).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1122 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.date: Eli's death on hearing of the Ark's capture "must have taken place around November or December of the previous year (1122 BC)"
chronologies.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), ch. V "Chart Four", p. 87
chronologies.note: Chart No. 4: "1122 BC ELI DIES UPON HEARING THE CAPTURE OF THE ARK AGE 98"; Ark returned 1121 BC after 7 months.

chronologies.date: 2888d AM, 1116 BC (Ark taken at Ebenezer; Hophni and Phinehas slain; Eli dies)
chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §386 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
chronologies.note: §385 under the same year. §365: Eli "died at the age of 98 years ... in the year of the world 2888".

chronologies.date: "2881 - Death of Eli, beginning of Samuel's judgeship at Tabernacle and Samson's judgeship in the South. Likely birth of Jesse."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
chronologies.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry. Judges (1985), "Samson, Samuel, and Obed", p. 237: the battle of Mizpah "happened 20 years after the battle of Aphek (1 Sam. 7:2)"; Samson was "about 20 years old" at about the time of Aphek, when "Eli died and Samuel began his public ministry" (intervals only, no year).

chronologies.date: "2855 - Death of Eli, beginning of Samuel's judgeship at Tabernacle and Samson's judgeship in the South."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
chronologies.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). BC 5:2: "In the following year, 2855, the Ark was taken into captivity."

chronologies.date: Eli 98 years old; judged Israel 40 years
